title: Law to reform the Industrial Business Zone Boundary Commission
summary: This bill would expand the Industrial Business Zone Boundary Commission by adding two members appointed by the Council Speaker and one by the Public Advocate. It would require a two-thirds vote to amend or repeal existing industrial zone boundaries and require the commission to notify the Council of boundary changes within five business days. Commission members would be barred from holding financial interests in real estate or land use consulting firms or from being registered lobbyists, and meetings would have to be livestreamed with materials posted online.
